blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 透過四個真實案例，瞭解污染事件的根本原因調查 (Root Cause Investigation) 方法與矯正預防措施
blocks.en: Use four real-world cases to understand root cause investigation methods and corrective and preventive actions for contamination events

blocks.zh: 理解設備維護 (Equipment Maintenance)、設施施工 (Facility Construction) 與 BFS 設備設計對污染控制的關鍵影響
blocks.en: Understand the critical impact of equipment maintenance, facility construction and BFS equipment design on contamination control

blocks.zh: 掌握 Disruption Recovery Program（干擾復原計畫）的分級管理原則與具體步驟
blocks.en: Master the tiered management principles and specific steps of a Disruption Recovery Program

blocks.zh: 認識不同製程類型（開放步驟 vs 封閉系統、可重複使用 vs 一次性使用）如何影響 CCS 的重點設計
blocks.en: Recognize how different process types (open steps vs closed systems, reusable vs single-use) shape the design priorities of a CCS

blocks.zh: 學習 CCS 文件範本的標準結構，能夠應用於實際場域的污染控制策略文件撰寫
blocks.en: Learn the standard structure of a CCS document template so that it can be applied when writing a contamination control strategy document for an actual site

blocks.en: 17.0 Appendix 3: Case Studies for Contamination Control

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Case Study（案例研究）：TR-90 在此附錄中收錄了四個來自真實製藥工廠的污染事件案例，其中 Cases 1-3 屬於失敗案例分析，Case 4 則是正面的干擾管理程式範例。這些案例的共同主題都圍繞在「維護管控 (Maintenance Controls)」的薄弱環節。
blocks.en: Case Study: This appendix of TR 90 presents four contamination events from real pharmaceutical plants. Cases 1-3 are analyses of failures, while Case 4 is a positive example of a disruption management program. The common theme of all four is weak points in maintenance controls.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 這四個案例就像醫院的「感染事件回顧會議」——每當發生院內感染時，醫院會進行根因分析、公開討論失誤環節，並制定改善措施。製藥工廠的污染事件同樣需要這種透明、系統化的檢討機制，從錯誤中學習才能持續改善。
blocks.en: These four cases are like a hospital "infection event review meeting": whenever a hospital-acquired infection occurs, the hospital performs a root cause analysis, openly discusses where things went wrong and puts improvement measures in place. Contamination events in a pharmaceutical plant call for the same transparent, systematic review mechanism, because continuous improvement comes from learning from mistakes.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 注意這些案例的文獻來源：Cases 1-3 來自 FDA 官員 Richard L. Friedman 發表的學術論文，代表了 FDA 稽查中常見的污染問題模式。這不僅是學術討論，更是 FDA 審查關注的重點。
blocks.en: Note the literature source of these cases: Cases 1-3 come from academic papers published by FDA official Richard L. Friedman, and they represent common patterns of contamination problems seen in FDA inspections. This is not just academic discussion; it is also what FDA review focuses on.

blocks.zh: 17.1 Case Study 1: Contamination Related to Equipment Maintenance 17.1 案例研究一：與設備維護保養相關之污染
blocks.en: 17.1 Case Study 1: Contamination Related to Equipment Maintenance

blocks.zh: Fermenter Contamination（發酵槽污染）：此案例涉及生物製劑生產中的發酵槽，被芽孢桿菌屬 (Bacillus cereus 和 Paenibacillus curdlanolyticus) 污染。這兩種都是產芽孢菌 (spore-forming bacteria)，芽孢的耐受性極強，能夠存活於一般滅菌條件下的微環境死角。
blocks.en: Fermenter Contamination: This case involves a fermenter used in biologics manufacturing that was contaminated with Bacillus species (Bacillus cereus and Paenibacillus curdlanolyticus). Both are spore-forming bacteria; spores are extremely resistant and can survive in micro-environmental dead spots under ordinary sterilization conditions.

blocks.zh: Media Simulation（培養基模擬）：類似無菌製程模擬 (APS)，使用培養基替代產品在發酵槽中運行，以偵測無菌邊界的突破點。這是調查工具中非常有價值的手段。
blocks.en: Media Simulation: Similar to an aseptic process simulation (APS), culture medium is run through the fermenter in place of product to detect where the sterile boundary has been breached. It is a very valuable investigation tool.

blocks.zh: Engineering Batch（工程批）：專門為調查或驗證目的而生產的非商業批次，用於重現問題條件並驗證修正措施的有效性。
blocks.en: Engineering Batch: A non-commercial batch produced specifically for investigation or validation purposes, used to reproduce the problem conditions and verify the effectiveness of corrective measures.

blocks.zh: 發酵槽的無菌邊界就像潛水艇的船殼——任何一個微小的縫隙（O-ring 缺失、閥膜損壞、冷凝水管斜度不足）都可能讓「水」（微生物）滲入。而芽孢菌就像頑強的種子，一旦通過裂縫進入，即使條件暫時不利也能等待時機萌發。
blocks.en: The sterile boundary of a fermenter is like the hull of a submarine: any tiny gap (a missing O-ring, a damaged valve diaphragm, insufficient slope in a condensate line) can let in the "water" (microorganisms). Spore formers are like hardy seeds: once they get in through a crack, they can wait for their chance to germinate even if conditions are temporarily unfavorable.

blocks.zh: 多重根因：本案最終無法確認單一明確根因 (unequivocal root cause)，這在實務中非常常見。正確做法是：辨識所有可能的原因並全面矯正。
blocks.en: Multiple root causes: This case ultimately could not confirm a single unequivocal root cause, which is very common in practice. The correct approach is to identify all possible causes and correct them comprehensively.

blocks.zh: CAPA 範圍：矯正行動包含硬體（更換閥膜、O-ring）、製程（強化滅菌程序）、制度（建立 PM 計畫、SOP 更新、人員訓練）三個層面——這是完整 CAPA 的典範。
blocks.en: CAPA scope: Corrective actions covered three levels: hardware (replacing valve diaphragms and O-rings), process (strengthening the sterilization procedure) and system (establishing a PM program, updating SOPs, training personnel). This is a model of a complete CAPA.

blocks.zh: 常見無菌邊界薄弱點：排氣過濾器 (vent filters)、O-rings、隔膜 (diaphragms)、彈性體 (elastomers)、冷凝水管線斜度不足。
blocks.en: Common weak points in the sterile boundary: vent filters, O-rings, diaphragms, elastomers and insufficient slope of condensate lines.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 對於 CDMO 而言，發酵槽是高價值設備，停機調查的成本極高。建立完善的預防性維護 (PM) 計畫——特別是針對所有閥門、密封件的定期更換週期——是避免此類事件的最佳投資。建議將關鍵密封元件 (O-rings、隔膜) 納入物料管理系統，確保有足夠的安全庫存。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, fermenters are high-value equipment, and the cost of downtime for an investigation is very high. Establishing a sound preventive maintenance (PM) program, particularly regular replacement intervals for all valves and seals, is the best investment for avoiding this kind of event. It is advisable to include critical sealing components (O-rings, diaphragms) in the materials management system to ensure adequate safety stock.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼芽孢菌 (spore-forming bacteria) 特別容易成為發酵槽污染的元兇？
blocks.en: Why are spore-forming bacteria particularly likely to be the culprit in fermenter contamination?

blocks.zh: 當無法確定單一根因時，調查團隊應採取什麼策略來確保完整性？
blocks.en: When a single root cause cannot be determined, what strategy should the investigation team adopt to ensure completeness?

blocks.zh: Media simulation 在根因調查中扮演什麼角色？它與 APS 有何異同？
blocks.en: What role does media simulation play in root cause investigation? How is it similar to and different from APS?

blocks.zh: 17.2 Case Study 2: Contamination Related to Blow-Fill-Seal Equipment Design and Maintenance 17.2 案例研究二：與吹灌封設備設計及維護保養相關之污染
blocks.en: 17.2 Case Study 2: Contamination Related to Blow-Fill-Seal Equipment Design and Maintenance

blocks.zh: Blow-Fill-Seal (BFS，吹灌封)：一種將容器成形、充填與密封整合在同一設備中完成的無菌充填技術。BFS 模具需要冷卻水來維持成形溫度。
blocks.en: Blow-Fill-Seal (BFS): An aseptic filling technology in which container forming, filling and sealing are all completed within a single piece of equipment. BFS molds require cooling water to maintain the forming temperature.

blocks.zh: Pinhole Leak（針孔滲漏）：模具板上極微小的穿孔，肉眼難以察覺，但足以讓微生物隨冷卻水滲入產品。這是 BFS 特有的污染風險。
blocks.en: Pinhole Leak: A tiny perforation in the mold plate that is hard to see with the naked eye but is enough to let microorganisms enter the product along with the cooling water. This is a contamination risk specific to BFS.

blocks.zh: Cooling Water Contamination（冷卻水污染）：去礦化飲用水在低溫槽中長期靜置，導致微生物大量繁殖。冷卻水系統往往被忽視，但它與產品之間僅隔著一層模具板金屬。
blocks.en: Cooling Water Contamination: Demineralized potable water left standing for a long time in a low-temperature tank allows microorganisms to proliferate heavily. The cooling water system is often overlooked, yet it is separated from the product by only a layer of mold plate metal.

blocks.zh: BFS 模具上的針孔滲漏就像冰箱背面冷凝管的微小裂縫——冷媒（污染物）會緩慢且不知不覺地洩漏。你可能長時間都不知道問題存在，直到冰箱（產品）開始出問題。而「目視檢查」就像只用眼睛看冷媒管有沒有漏——顯然不夠，你需要壓力測試才能發現微小滲漏。
blocks.en: A pinhole leak in a BFS mold is like a tiny crack in the condenser tubing at the back of a refrigerator: the refrigerant (the contaminant) leaks out slowly and unnoticed. You may not know the problem exists for a long time, until the refrigerator (the product) starts to have problems. "Visual inspection" is like checking only by eye whether the refrigerant tube is leaking, which is clearly not enough; you need a pressure test to find tiny leaks.

blocks.zh: 設備設計缺陷 + 維護不足 = 災難：冷卻水系統與產品只有一層金屬板相隔，若維護不足，設備老化後針孔漏洞不可避免。
blocks.en: Equipment design flaw + inadequate maintenance = disaster: The cooling water system is separated from the product by only a metal plate. With inadequate maintenance, pinhole leaks are inevitable once the equipment ages.

blocks.zh: 目視檢查的局限性：本案明確指出「頻繁的目視檢查不足以提供充分的預防性維護」，必須採用壓力完整性測試等定量方法。
blocks.en: Limits of visual inspection: The case states explicitly that "frequent visual inspection is not sufficient for adequate preventive maintenance"; quantitative methods such as pressure integrity testing must be used.

blocks.zh: 追溯困難：由於不知道問題發生的確切日期，大量批次被拒絕放行。這凸顯了持續監控的重要性——越早發現，影響範圍越小。
blocks.en: Difficulty of tracing back: Because the exact date the problem began was unknown, a large number of batches were rejected. This highlights the importance of continuous monitoring: the earlier a problem is found, the smaller its impact.

blocks.zh: 微生物特徵：Stenotrophomonas maltophilia、Pseudomonas spp.、Acinetobacter spp. 都是典型的水系統相關微生物。
blocks.en: Microbial profile: Stenotrophomonas maltophilia, Pseudomonas spp. and Acinetobacter spp. are all typical water-system-associated microorganisms.

blocks.zh: 為什麼冷卻水系統中的微生物能夠直接影響 BFS 產品的無菌性？
blocks.en: Why can microorganisms in the cooling water system directly affect the sterility of BFS product?

blocks.zh: 除了壓力完整性測試，還有哪些方法可以監控 BFS 模具的狀態？
blocks.en: Besides pressure integrity testing, what other methods can be used to monitor the condition of BFS molds?

blocks.zh: 如果你是品質主管，如何設計一個 BFS 冷卻水系統的監控計畫？
blocks.en: If you were the head of quality, how would you design a monitoring program for a BFS cooling water system?

blocks.zh: 17.3 Case Study 3: Contamination Related to Facility Construction 17.3 案例研究三：與廠房建造相關之污染
blocks.en: 17.3 Case Study 3: Contamination Related to Facility Construction

blocks.zh: Construction Contamination Migration（施工污染遷移）：施工活動（拆除牆面、管路改造等）會釋放大量微粒和微生物（特別是芽孢菌和真菌），這些污染物可以透過空調系統或壓差不足沿著氣流路徑遷移到遠處的無菌作業區。
blocks.en: Construction Contamination Migration: Construction activities (demolishing walls, modifying piping, etc.) release large quantities of particles and microorganisms (especially spore formers and fungi). These contaminants can migrate along airflow paths, through the HVAC system or because of insufficient pressure differentials, to aseptic operation areas far away.

blocks.zh: Change Control（變更管制）：任何偏離正常經確效條件的活動都應通過正式的變更管制或偏差系統進行評估。施工活動屬於重大變更，必須事前進行風險評估。
blocks.en: Change Control: Any activity that deviates from normal validated conditions should be evaluated through a formal change control or deviation system. Construction activity is a major change and requires a risk assessment beforehand.

blocks.zh: 施工污染遷移就像隔壁房間的裝潢粉塵——即使你關了自己房間的門，灰塵仍然會通過門縫、通風管道、共用走廊慢慢飄進來。更危險的是，牆壁內部可能藏著幾十年的黴菌孢子，一旦拆牆就會大量釋放。「距離很遠所以沒關係」是最危險的假設。
blocks.en: Construction contamination migration is like renovation dust from the next room: even if you close the door of your own room, dust still drifts in through gaps under the door, ventilation ducts and shared corridors. More dangerous still, the walls may hide decades of mold spores that are released in large quantities once a wall is demolished. "It is far away, so it does not matter" is the most dangerous assumption.

blocks.zh: FDA 常見觀察：FDA 指出這種場景「令人驚訝地頻繁 (surprising frequency)」發生——廠商往往低估施工對遠端區域的影響。
blocks.en: Common FDA observation: FDA notes that this scenario occurs with "surprising frequency", as firms often underestimate the effect of construction on remote areas.

blocks.zh: 首次調查方向錯誤：廠方最初將根因歸咎於「與施工無關的操作」，直到第二次 media fill 再次失敗才正視施工的影響，造成了時間和批次的雙重損失。
blocks.en: First investigation went in the wrong direction: The firm initially attributed the root cause to "operations unrelated to construction" and only faced the impact of construction after the second media fill failed again, causing losses of both time and batches.

blocks.zh: 後果嚴重：產品召回 (recall) + 暫停生產——這是任何廠商都無法承受的代價。
blocks.en: Serious consequences: Product recall plus suspension of production, a cost no firm can afford.

blocks.zh: 正確做法：施工期間應停止生產，或至少設置實體隔離屏障、加強環境監控、增加非例行取樣。
blocks.en: Correct approach: Production should be stopped during construction, or at the least physical isolation barriers should be set up, environmental monitoring strengthened and additional non-routine sampling performed.

blocks.zh: CDMO 經常面臨在不停產的情況下進行設施升級的壓力。最佳實務是：在施工計畫階段即成立跨部門小組（工程、品質、生產），進行正式的風險評估，明確定義隔離措施、加強監控方案、以及「停止生產」的觸發條件 (trigger criteria)。寧可主動停產一週，也不要被動召回一整批產品。
blocks.en: CDMOs often face pressure to carry out facility upgrades without stopping production. Best practice is to set up a cross-functional team (engineering, quality, production) at the construction planning stage, perform a formal risk assessment, and clearly define isolation measures, an enhanced monitoring program and the trigger criteria for "stop production". It is better to proactively halt production for a week than to be forced to recall an entire batch of product.

blocks.zh: 為什麼「距離遠」並不能保證施工不會影響無菌作業區的環境？
blocks.en: Why does "being far away" not guarantee that construction will not affect the environment of the aseptic area?

blocks.zh: 本案中第一次調查結論為什麼是錯誤的？這對調查方法論有什麼啟示？
blocks.en: Why was the conclusion of the first investigation in this case wrong? What does it teach about investigation methodology?

blocks.zh: 如果你的工廠需要在生產期間進行施工，你會設計哪些控制措施？
blocks.en: If your plant needs to carry out construction during production, what control measures would you design?

blocks.zh: 17.4 Case Study 4: Disruption Recovery Program 17.4 案例研究四：中斷復原計畫
blocks.en: 17.4 Case Study 4: Disruption Recovery Program

blocks.zh: Disruption Recovery Program（干擾復原計畫）：一套預先定義的管理程序，用於處理對分級區域或關鍵公用設施造成干擾的事件。其核心原則是「分級管理」——根據干擾的嚴重程度採取相應的控制措施。
blocks.en: Disruption Recovery Program: A predefined management procedure for handling events that disrupt classified areas or critical utilities. Its core principle is tiered management: applying controls that correspond to the severity of the disruption.

blocks.zh: Noninvasive vs Invasive Disruption（非侵入性 vs 侵入性干擾）：
blocks.en: Noninvasive vs Invasive Disruption:

blocks.zh: Level 1 非侵入性：不破壞分級區域完整性，且在無作業時進行（如校正、填縫修補）
blocks.en: Level 1, noninvasive: Does not breach the integrity of the classified area and is performed when no operations are under way (for example calibration, caulking repairs)

blocks.zh: Level 2 侵入性：破壞分級區域完整性，且在生產進行時發生（如開啟電氣面板、管路焊接）
blocks.en: Level 2, invasive: Breaches the integrity of the classified area and occurs while production is under way (for example opening an electrical panel, pipe welding)

blocks.zh: Level 3 公用設施：涉及關鍵公用設施系統的維護或修復
blocks.en: Level 3, utilities: Involves maintenance or repair of critical utility systems

blocks.zh: 干擾復原計畫就像醫院手術室的「緊急維修 SOP」：
blocks.en: A disruption recovery program is like the "emergency repair SOP" of a hospital operating room:

blocks.zh: Level 1 = 換燈泡——可以在手術之間進行，簡單擦拭即可
blocks.en: Level 1 = changing a light bulb: can be done between surgeries, with a simple wipe-down

blocks.zh: Level 2 = 修天花板管線——需要搭臨時隔板、吸塵、全面消毒後才能重新使用
blocks.en: Level 2 = repairing ceiling pipework: temporary partitions, vacuuming and full disinfection are needed before the room can be used again

blocks.zh: Level 3 = 修理供水系統——必須隔離管路、消毒後檢測合格才能恢復供水
blocks.en: Level 3 = repairing the water supply system: the piping must be isolated and disinfected, and testing must pass before the water supply is restored

blocks.zh: 計畫優先原則：例行性事件（PM、校正、確效）應儘量安排在停機期間進行，將對分級區域的影響降到最低。
blocks.en: Planning priority principle: Routine events (PM, calibration, validation) should be scheduled during shutdown periods wherever possible, to minimize the impact on classified areas.

blocks.zh: Sporicide（殺孢子劑）的使用：Level 1 中暴露髒表面時需要使用殺孢子劑進行目標性消毒；Level 2 更是必須使用。這呼應了 Case Study 3 中芽孢菌遷移的問題。
blocks.en: Use of sporicide: At Level 1, targeted disinfection with a sporicide is needed when dirty surfaces are exposed; at Level 2 it is mandatory. This echoes the spore-former migration problem in Case Study 3.

blocks.zh: 復原確認 = EM 合格：恢復生產前必須透過環境監控結果確認環境已回到受控狀態，這不是「走形式」而是「放行條件」。
blocks.en: Recovery confirmation = EM acceptance: Before production resumes, environmental monitoring results must confirm that the environment has returned to a controlled state. This is not a formality but a release condition.

blocks.zh: 風險相稱原則 (commensurate with risk)：復原措施的力度應與干擾的風險等級相匹配，避免過度反應浪費資源，也避免不足導致污染。
blocks.en: Commensurate with risk: The intensity of recovery measures should match the risk level of the disruption, avoiding overreaction that wastes resources as well as insufficient action that leads to contamination.

blocks.zh: 建議每個 CDMO 工廠都建立一份「Disruption Recovery Matrix」，將所有可能的維護/施工事件按照 Level 1/2/3 分類，並預先定義每個類別的：(1) 隔離措施、(2) 清潔/消毒程序、(3) 環境監控方案、(4) 恢復生產前的放行標準。這樣在事件發生時就能快速啟動預定的復原程序，而不是臨時決定。
blocks.en: It is recommended that every CDMO site establish a "Disruption Recovery Matrix" that classifies all possible maintenance and construction events as Level 1/2/3 and predefines, for each category: (1) isolation measures, (2) cleaning and disinfection procedures, (3) the environmental monitoring program and (4) release criteria before production resumes. This allows the predefined recovery procedure to be activated quickly when an event occurs, rather than making ad hoc decisions.

blocks.zh: 如何判斷一個維護事件應歸類為 Level 1 還是 Level 2？關鍵判斷標準是什麼？
blocks.en: How do you decide whether a maintenance event should be classified as Level 1 or Level 2? What are the key criteria?

blocks.zh: Table 17.4-2🔍 中為什麼 Level 2 需要「static and dynamic monitoring」而 Level 1 只需要 routine EM？
blocks.en: In Table 17.4-2🔍, why does Level 2 require "static and dynamic monitoring" while Level 1 requires only routine EM?

blocks.zh: 設計一個你工廠中某項常見維護事件的完整 Disruption Recovery Plan。
blocks.en: Design a complete Disruption Recovery Plan for a common maintenance event at your site.

blocks.zh: 18.0 Appendix 4: Illustration of CCS Variability based on Process 18.0 附錄 4：基於製程之污染管制策略（CCS）變異性說明
blocks.en: 18.0 Appendix 4: Illustration of CCS Variability based on Process

blocks.zh: CCS Variability（CCS 差異性）：有效的污染控制策略必須針對特定製程的風險進行客製化 (tailored)。不存在「一體適用」的 CCS——不同的製程特性決定了不同的風險輪廓和控制重點。
blocks.en: CCS Variability: An effective contamination control strategy must be tailored to the risks of the specific process. There is no "one size fits all" CCS: different process characteristics determine different risk profiles and control priorities.

blocks.zh: 三種製程代表了典型的風險頻譜：
blocks.en: The three processes represent a typical risk spectrum:

blocks.zh: Process 1（高風險）：開放步驟多 + 可重複使用設備 + 複雜管路 = 環境暴露風險最高、清潔/滅菌挑戰最大
blocks.en: Process 1 (high risk): Many open steps + reusable equipment + complex piping = the highest risk of environmental exposure and the greatest cleaning/sterilization challenges

blocks.zh: Process 2（中風險）：少量開放步驟 + 一次性使用系統 + 動物來源原料 = 外源因子 (adventitious agents) 風險
blocks.en: Process 2 (medium risk): Few open steps + single-use systems + animal-derived raw materials = risk of adventitious agents

blocks.zh: Process 3（低風險）：無開放步驟 + 預組裝一次性套件 = 環境風險最低，但供應商品質風險仍需管控
blocks.en: Process 3 (low risk): No open steps + preassembled single-use kits = lowest environmental risk, but supplier quality risk still needs to be controlled

blocks.zh: 三種製程就像三種不同的餐飲模式：
blocks.en: The three processes are like three different food service models:

blocks.zh: Process 1 = 傳統餐廳廚房——開放的烹飪環境，可重複使用的鍋碗瓢盆需要徹底清洗，管線（水管、油管）複雜容易藏污納垢
blocks.en: Process 1 = a traditional restaurant kitchen: an open cooking environment, reusable pots and pans that need thorough washing, and complex plumbing (water pipes, oil lines) that easily harbors dirt

blocks.zh: Process 2 = 使用預包裝食材的現代餐廳——部分食材需要現場拆封（開放步驟少），大量使用一次性容器，但某些原料（如生肉）有特殊衛生要求
blocks.en: Process 2 = a modern restaurant using prepackaged ingredients: some ingredients must be unpacked on site (few open steps), many single-use containers are used, but certain raw materials (such as raw meat) have special hygiene requirements

blocks.zh: Process 3 = 全自動化的即食餐生產線——食材全部在密封系統中處理，人員幾乎不接觸，主要風險是包材供應商的品質
blocks.en: Process 3 = a fully automated ready-meal production line: ingredients are all handled in sealed systems with almost no human contact, and the main risk is the quality of the packaging material suppliers

blocks.zh: 所有 CCS 要素都適用：三種製程都需要涵蓋所有 CCS 要素，差異在於「哪些要素需要加強 (enhanced)」。
blocks.en: All CCS elements apply: All three processes need to address all CCS elements; the difference lies in which elements need to be enhanced.

blocks.zh: 開放步驟數量是關鍵驅動因素：開放步驟越多 = 環境和人員暴露風險越高 = 需要更嚴格的潔淨室等級。
blocks.en: The number of open steps is the key driver: The more open steps, the higher the risk of environmental and personnel exposure, and the stricter the cleanroom grade required.

blocks.zh: 一次性使用系統改變風險重點：從「清潔/滅菌/維護」轉向「供應商品質管控/使用前檢查/洩漏防護」。
blocks.en: Single-use systems shift the risk focus: From cleaning/sterilization/maintenance toward supplier quality control, pre-use inspection and leak protection.

blocks.zh: 動物來源原料引入特殊風險：外源因子 (adventitious agents) 和朊蛋白 (prions) 是生物製程特有的污染類型，需要擴展的表徵和預處理（如伽馬照射）。
blocks.en: Animal-derived raw materials introduce special risks: Adventitious agents and prions are contamination types specific to biological processes and require extended characterization and pretreatment (such as gamma irradiation).

blocks.zh: CDMO 往往同時服務多種製程類型的客戶。建議建立一份「CCS 基礎版」涵蓋所有通用要素，再根據每個產品/製程的特性，以附件形式增加需要加強的控制措施。這樣既能保證基礎一致性，又能體現製程特異性——稽查人員也更容易理解你的邏輯。
blocks.en: CDMOs often serve customers with several process types at the same time. It is recommended to establish a "CCS base version" covering all common elements, and then add the controls that need enhancement as annexes according to the characteristics of each product/process. This ensures baseline consistency while reflecting process specificity, and it is easier for inspectors to follow your logic.

blocks.zh: 如果你的工廠從 Process 1 型態轉型為 Process 2，CCS 中哪些要素的控制力度應該調降？哪些應該增強？
blocks.en: If your site moves from a Process 1 type to a Process 2 type, which CCS elements should have their level of control reduced, and which should be strengthened?

blocks.zh: 為什麼即使 Process 3 是最封閉的系統，CCS 仍然不能忽視供應商管控？
blocks.en: Even though Process 3 is the most closed system, why can the CCS still not neglect supplier control?

blocks.zh: 動物來源原料帶來的 adventitious agents 風險，與一般微生物風險的管控方法有何不同？
blocks.en: How does the control approach for adventitious agent risk from animal-derived raw materials differ from that for general microbial risk?

blocks.zh: 19.0 Appendix 5: Template Example for Contamination Control Strategy Document 19.0 附錄 5：污染管制策略文件範本
blocks.en: 19.0 Appendix 5: Template Example for Contamination Control Strategy Document

blocks.zh: CCS Document Template（CCS 文件範本）：此範本提供了一個標準化但可客製化的 CCS 文件架構。重點不是「照抄範本」，而是理解每個章節背後的邏輯，並根據自己工廠的實際情況填寫具體內容。
blocks.en: CCS Document Template: This template provides a standardized yet customizable CCS document structure. The point is not to "copy the template" but to understand the logic behind each section and fill in specific content according to the actual situation at your own site.

blocks.zh: 文件的兩大讀者群：
blocks.en: The two main audiences of the document:

blocks.zh: Inspectors（稽查員）：CCS 文件是展示工廠整體污染控制邏輯的「導覽地圖」，讓稽查員快速理解你的策略架構。
blocks.en: Inspectors: The CCS document is a "road map" showing the overall contamination control logic of the site, letting inspectors quickly understand the structure of your strategy.

blocks.zh: Site Employees（場域員工）：CCS 文件幫助所有人理解各控制要素之間的關聯性，避免局部變更破壞整體策略。
blocks.en: Site Employees: The CCS document helps everyone understand the relationships among the control elements, so that a local change does not undermine the overall strategy.

blocks.zh: CCS 文件就像一棟建築物的「安全防護總設計圖」。它不是每扇門鎖的安裝手冊（那是 SOP），也不是每次安全巡邏的紀錄（那是 Batch Record），而是展示整體安全理念的總圖——門禁在哪、監視器怎麼配置、消防系統如何設計、保全人員如何巡邏。30-50 頁的篇幅意味著它是「鳥瞰圖」而非「細節圖」。
blocks.en: A CCS document is like the "master security design drawing" of a building. It is not the installation manual for each door lock (that is an SOP), nor the record of each security patrol (that is a batch record), but the master drawing that shows the overall security philosophy: where the access control is, how the cameras are laid out, how the fire protection system is designed and how security staff patrol. A length of 30-50 pages means it is a "bird's-eye view" rather than a "detail drawing".

blocks.zh: Use factual, active voice：描述「工廠實際在做什麼」(do occur)，而非「應該做什麼」(shall occur)。這是 CCS 與 SOP 的根本區別——SOP 是指令式的，CCS 是描述式的。
blocks.en: Use factual, active voice: Describe "what the site actually does" (do occur) rather than "what should be done" (shall occur). This is the fundamental difference between a CCS and an SOP: an SOP is directive, whereas a CCS is descriptive.

blocks.zh: 30-50 頁目標：CCS 不是百科全書，而是「帶有參考引用的摘要」。過度詳細反而會讓讀者迷失在細節中，失去對整體策略的理解。
blocks.en: 30-50 page target: A CCS is not an encyclopedia but a "summary with reference citations". Too much detail makes readers lose themselves in the details and lose their grasp of the overall strategy.

blocks.zh: 多工廠/多產品策略：
blocks.en: Multi-site / multi-product strategy:

blocks.zh: 同類製程 + 同一 CCS = 可以一份文件涵蓋所有產品
blocks.en: Similar processes + the same CCS = one document can cover all products

blocks.zh: 不同類製程 = 需要分別撰寫
blocks.en: Different types of processes = separate documents are needed

blocks.zh: 供應鏈上下游 = 各站撰寫自己的 CCS，互相引用
blocks.en: Upstream and downstream in the supply chain = each node writes its own CCS and they cross-reference each other

blocks.zh: 15 個 CCS 要素對應 TR90 章節：範本中每個要素都明確標註了對應的 TR90 章節編號，這是撰寫 CCS 時回顧原始指引的最佳索引。
blocks.en: 15 CCS elements mapped to TR90 sections: Each element in the template is clearly labeled with the corresponding TR90 section number, which is the best index for going back to the original guidance when writing a CCS.

blocks.zh: 撰寫 CCS 文件的實務建議：
blocks.en: Practical advice for writing a CCS document:

blocks.zh: 從 Section 3 (Scope) 開始：先明確定義範圍——哪些產品、哪些區域、哪段供應鏈。
blocks.en: Start with Section 3 (Scope): First define the scope clearly: which products, which areas, which part of the supply chain.

blocks.zh: 善用 Process Map：在 Section 5.1 中以圖形呈現製程流程和控制點，比文字描述更有效。
blocks.en: Make good use of the Process Map: Presenting the process flow and control points graphically in Section 5.1 is more effective than a text description.

blocks.zh: 引用而非複製：每個要素只需寫 1-2 段摘要，然後引用詳細的 SOP/報告/風險評估文件。
blocks.en: Reference rather than copy: Each element needs only 1-2 paragraphs of summary, followed by references to the detailed SOPs/reports/risk assessment documents.

blocks.zh: 定期更新：CCS 是活的文件 (living document)，每次重大變更、偏差事件、或年度審查都應觸發更新。
blocks.en: Update regularly: The CCS is a living document; every major change, deviation event or annual review should trigger an update.

blocks.zh: 跨部門協作：指派品質部門擁有 (own) CCS 文件，但撰寫時需要生產、工程、微生物、確效等團隊的輸入。
blocks.en: Cross-functional collaboration: Assign the quality unit to own the CCS document, but writing it requires input from teams such as production, engineering, microbiology and validation.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 CCS 文件要用「factual, active voice」而非「shall」語句？這與 SOP 的寫作風格有何不同？
blocks.en: Why should a CCS document use "factual, active voice" rather than "shall" statements? How does this differ from the writing style of an SOP?

blocks.zh: 如果你的 CDMO 同時生產無菌注射液和口服固體劑型，你會寫幾份 CCS 文件？為什麼？
blocks.en: If your CDMO produces both sterile injectables and oral solid dosage forms, how many CCS documents would you write? Why?

blocks.zh: 範本中的 15 個 CCS 要素中，哪 3-5 個你認為是最難寫好的？為什麼？
blocks.en: Of the 15 CCS elements in the template, which 3-5 do you think are the hardest to write well? Why?

blocks.zh: TR90 Complete Report Summary TR90 完整報告摘要
blocks.en: TR90 Complete Report Summary

blocks.zh: TR90 全報告總結 Complete Report Summary
blocks.en: Complete Report Summary

blocks.zh: CCS 的核心精神：Contamination Control Strategy (污染控制策略) 不是一份靜態文件，而是一個涵蓋設計、建造、運營、監控、改善的全生命週期系統。它要求從「整體性 (holistic)」的角度理解所有控制措施之間的關聯。
blocks.en: The core spirit of the CCS: A Contamination Control Strategy is not a static document but a lifecycle system covering design, construction, operation, monitoring and improvement. It requires understanding the relationships among all control measures from a holistic perspective.

blocks.zh: 風險為基礎的方法：TR90 始終強調 CCS 必須以風險評估為驅動力——辨識污染源、評估風險等級、設計相應控制措施、並持續監控有效性。Risk 不是一次性評估，而是動態循環。
blocks.en: Risk-based approach: TR90 consistently stresses that a CCS must be driven by risk assessment: identify contamination sources, assess risk levels, design corresponding control measures and continuously monitor their effectiveness. Risk is not a one-time assessment but a dynamic cycle.

blocks.zh: 十五大 CCS 要素：從設施設計、環境監控、製程設計、設備維護、人員管控、原物料管理、公用設施、警報系統、容器密封、供應商管理、品質系統、到治理與績效審查——每個要素都是整體策略的一環。
blocks.en: The fifteen CCS elements: From facility design, environmental monitoring, process design, equipment maintenance, personnel control, raw material management, utilities, alarm systems, container closure, supplier management and quality systems, through to governance and performance review, each element is a part of the overall strategy.

blocks.zh: 環境監控 (EM) 的雙重角色：EM 既是「偵測工具」也是「趨勢分析工具」。單次數據確認即時狀態，長期趨勢揭示系統性漂移。Contamination Recovery Program 的核心就是透過 EM 確認復原。
blocks.en: The dual role of environmental monitoring (EM): EM is both a "detection tool" and a "trend analysis tool". A single data point confirms the immediate status, while long-term trends reveal systematic drift. The core of a Contamination Recovery Program is to confirm recovery through EM.

blocks.zh: 設備維護是隱藏的關鍵風險：四個案例研究中，有三個與維護相關的失敗直接導致了污染事件。Preventive Maintenance Plan、Disruption Recovery Program 是 CCS 中不可或缺的組成部分。
blocks.en: Equipment maintenance is a hidden critical risk: Of the four case studies, three involved maintenance-related failures that directly led to contamination events. A Preventive Maintenance Plan and a Disruption Recovery Program are indispensable components of a CCS.

blocks.zh: 微生物數據的整合運用：從微生物鑑定 (identification)、環境趨勢 (trending)、到微生物影響評估 (Microbial Impact Assessment)，TR90 展示了如何將微生物學知識整合進品質決策中。
blocks.en: Integrated use of microbiological data: From microbial identification and environmental trending to Microbial Impact Assessment, TR90 shows how to integrate microbiological knowledge into quality decisions.

blocks.zh: CCS 文件的撰寫原則：30-50 頁、事實描述語氣、引用而非複製、針對稽查員和員工的雙重讀者群設計。文件結構應涵蓋所有 15 個要素，並根據製程特性調整重點。
blocks.en: Principles for writing a CCS document: 30-50 pages, factual descriptive tone, reference rather than copy, and design for the dual audience of inspectors and employees. The document structure should cover all 15 elements and adjust the emphasis according to process characteristics.

blocks.zh: 持續改善是最終目標：CCS 不是通過稽查的工具，而是推動製造品質持續提升的引擎。每次偏差調查、CAPA 執行、年度審查都是改善 CCS 的契機。
blocks.en: Continuous improvement is the ultimate goal: A CCS is not a tool for passing inspections but an engine that drives continuous improvement in manufacturing quality. Every deviation investigation, CAPA implementation and annual review is an opportunity to improve the CCS.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary (Appendices 3-5)
blocks.en: Section Summary (Appendices 3-5)

blocks.zh: Case Studies 1-3：三個真實污染事件（發酵槽維護缺陷、BFS 冷卻水滲漏、施工污染遷移）都指向維護管控和變更管制的薄弱環節，造成批次拒絕、產品召回、停產等嚴重後果。
blocks.en: Case Studies 1-3: Three real contamination events (fermenter maintenance deficiencies, BFS cooling water leakage, construction contamination migration) all point to weak points in maintenance controls and change control, resulting in serious consequences such as batch rejection, product recall and production shutdown.

blocks.zh: Case Study 4：Disruption Recovery Program 提供了分級管理框架（Level 1-3），從隔離、清潔消毒到環境監控復原，確保維護/施工事件不會危及產品品質。
blocks.en: Case Study 4: The Disruption Recovery Program provides a tiered management framework (Levels 1-3), covering isolation, cleaning and disinfection, and recovery through environmental monitoring, to ensure that maintenance/construction events do not endanger product quality.

blocks.zh: CCS 製程差異性：開放 vs 封閉步驟、可重複使用 vs 一次性設備、合成 vs 生物製程——不同特性決定不同的風險重點和控制強化方向。
blocks.en: CCS variability by process: Open vs closed steps, reusable vs single-use equipment, and synthetic vs biological processes: different characteristics determine different risk priorities and directions for strengthening controls.

blocks.zh: CCS 文件範本：8 大章節、15 個控制要素，提供了標準化但可客製化的文件架構。關鍵是描述「實際在做什麼」而非「應該做什麼」。
blocks.en: CCS document template: 8 major sections and 15 control elements provide a standardized yet customizable document structure. The key is to describe what is "actually being done" rather than what "should be done".

blocks.zh: 從案例到制度：這三個附錄形成完美的學習閉環——Case Studies 告訴你「什麼會出錯」，CCS Variability 告訴你「如何客製化策略」，Template 告訴你「如何落筆成文」。
blocks.en: From cases to systems: These three appendices form a complete learning loop: the Case Studies tell you "what can go wrong", CCS Variability tells you "how to tailor the strategy", and the Template tells you "how to put it in writing".
